requirement.normalizedRequirement: For category A, category B, and ice-strengthened category C ships, scantling_approval_status shall be approved by the Administration or an accepted recognized organization; the approval standard shall be accepted or provide equivalent safety, and category C approval shall address operating-area ice type and concentration.
requirement.requiredInputs: Ship category, ice-strengthening status, scantling approval, and standard evidence
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Scantlings of category A ships shall be approved by the Administration, or a recognized organization accepted by it, taking into account standards acceptable to the Organization or other standards offering an equivalent level of safety; scantlings of category B ships shall be approved by the Administration, or a recognized organization accepted by it, taking into account standards acceptable to the Organization or other standards offering an equivalent level of safety; and scantlings of ice strengthened category C ships shall be approved by the Administration, or a recognized organization accepted by it, taking into account acceptable standards adequate for the ice types and concentrations encountered in the area of operation.
